status: Production proxy fix and final credential isolation verified locally; migration and release incomplete
changes: Host captures active proxy configuration at startup, including disabled state; newly opened workers retain that snapshot until host restart.
Agent bootstrap carries active proxy configuration; metadata-only workers do not install relays.
Bun worker installs authenticated loopback HTTP and HTTPS relays via native HTTP_PROXY and HTTPS_PROXY before SDK initialization; no SDK patch or WebSocket replacement.
Only default TLS ports on api.openai.com, auth.openai.com and chatgpt.com select the application upstream. Other destinations retain captured ambient proxies and native bypass behavior.
HTTP and HTTPS upstreams, native OAuth refresh, global WebSocket and inspectable Bun ws are exercised using local fixtures. Upstream failure never triggers direct fallback.
Stop and shutdown close owned relay requests and sockets. Peer workers remain independent.
Native NO_PROXY and explicit per-request proxy priority remain unchanged; deliberate native bypass can bypass the relay.
Existing host/browser test uses OMP configuration and current model-management label; original auth, origin, persistence, restart and transport assertions retained.

Strip URL username/password from the address passed to http(s).request; emit upstream credentials exclusively in Proxy-Authorization. Preserve separately supplied origin Authorization. Real HTTP forwarding and CONNECT regression verifies encoded credentials and anonymous/authenticated targets.

credentialRegression.cause: Node-compatible http.request derives origin Authorization from credentials in its URL argument, even when Proxy-Authorization was supplied. The relay now passes a credential-free address and explicit proxy header.
